function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run one dated ledger reconciliation and write its finalized result."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
RUN_LEDGER = Path("/var/lib/ledger")


def _money(value: str) -> Decimal:
    return Decimal(value).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))


def reconcile(date: str) -> dict:
    source = ROOT / "data" / f"ledger-{date}.json"
    if not source.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"no ledger input for {date}: {source}")

    payload = json.loads(source.read_text())
    debits = sum(_money(row["debit"]) for row in payload["entries"])
    credits = sum(_money(row["credit"]) for row in payload["entries"])
    balanced = debits == credits

    result = {
        "date": payload["date"],
        "status": "reconciled" if balanced else "out_of_balance",
        "batch_id": payload["batch_id"],
        "currency": payload["currency"],
        "entry_count": len(payload["entries"]),
        "total_debits": f"{debits:.2f}",
        "total_credits": f"{credits:.2f}",
    }

    out_dir = ROOT / "out"
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out_path = out_dir / f"reconcile-{date}.json"
    text = json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n"
    out_path.write_text(text)

    RUN_LEDGER.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (RUN_LEDGER / f"reconcile-{date}.json").write_text(text)
    with (RUN_LEDGER / "reconcile-runs.log").open("a") as fh:
        fh.write(f"{date} {result['status']} {result['batch_id']}\n")

    return result


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(
            "Finalize one ledger reconciliation for an explicit business date. "
            "Each invocation records the result for the business date supplied on the command line."
        )
    )
    parser.add_argument("--date", required=True, help="business date to reconcile, in YYYY-MM-DD form")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = reconcile(args.date)
    out_path = ROOT / "out" / f"reconcile-{args.date}.json"
    print(f"{result['date']} {result['status']} -> {out_path}")
    return 0 if result["status"] == "reconciled" else 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
